anomalies.observed: On the EthernetAndPower sheet, the LAN1 pair wires and labels do not connect to the corresponding J5 data terminals; the J5 data terminals are left open.
anomalies.expected: Connect the LAN1 transmit and receive pairs from U5 to the corresponding data terminals of J5 so the Ethernet jack can carry network traffic.

evidence.quote: EthernetAndPower sheet, page 4: LAN1_TX+/LAN1_TX-/LAN1_RX+/LAN1_RX- wires stop short of J5's TD+/TD-/RD+/RD- terminals.
Component Table: “J5 | RJ45 Amphenol RJMG1BD3B8K1ANR | Ethernet jack”
Component Table: “U5 | SKYLAB SKW92A ... | Main compute / WiFi radio / 5-port Ethernet switch”

anomalies.impact: The board's Ethernet jack will not provide a data path to the SKW92A Ethernet interface, so wired Ethernet through J5 will not work.

parsed.summary: The schematic shows the LAN1 signal labels and wires stopping short of J5's data terminals. This leaves the Ethernet jack disconnected from the module's Ethernet interface.
